US, Russian, and Ukrainian officials are expected to meet this week in Abu Dhabi for talks on ending the nearly five-year war, but experts cautioned that the meetings were unlikely to yield a major breakthrough. The first direct negotiations in nine months will address “ security guarantees for Ukraine , Europe’s post-war security architecture and economic opportunities to support Ukraine’s reconstruction,” envoy Steve Witkoff said; Washington’s efforts to end the war have been primarily focused on rebuilding commercial ties , though earlier efforts surrounding a potential Alaskan LNG terminal collapsed in response to what US investors described as secret Russian control . “As long as the White House is satisfied with small gestures rather than actual concessions, Putin will not reverse course ,” an Atlantic Council expert wrote. — Brendan Ruberry

item.title: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes
item.description:
Houthi fighters took aim at the financial district of Saudi Arabia’s capital on Sunday — one of the highest-profile areas to be targeted in the war. A drone-and-missile attack damaged the iconic Saudi Aramco tower , located in an area that, as home to international companies and luxury housing, is a symbol of the kingdom’s modernization. Near-daily attacks in Riyadh have upended life and also forced the cancellation of a high-profile economic conference, putting pressure on Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman as he tries to keep on track a multi-trillion-dollar effort to position the kingdom as a destination for global capital. Saudi Arabia faces “ only bad options as it tries to find a way out of the conflict,” The Wall Street Journal wrote. — Kate McKenna

item.description:
